metadata.dataset_name: HalalSaver MY — Malaysian Grocery Product Dataset
data_sources: JAKIM Halal Portal (halal.gov.my) — simulated cert data
metadata.disclaimer: This dataset simulates product data from Malaysian hypermarkets for academic/FYP demonstration purposes only. Prices, availability, and halal certification details are approximated and may differ from actual store data. JAKIM certification data is simulated. Not for commercial use.
metadata.halal_note: Products marked 'Certified' reference simulated JAKIM cert numbers following the format MY-[STATE]-[YEAR]-[NUMBER]. Fresh produce (vegetables, fruits) is inherently halal and listed as Certified without a JAKIM reference number.
metadata.cbf_note: content_score represents Content-Based Filtering cosine similarity vs average Malaysian user preference vector. collab_score represents SVD++ collaborative filtering score. hybrid_score = 0.9 × max(content_score, collab_score) + 0.1 × popularity_score.
